## The question

How much of the fold could a viewer infer from reflected light while the paper stayed still?

## The experiment

I tested two light angles on the same paper and compared what remained readable on narrow screens.

## What I kept

Describe the behavior or design that earned a place in the prototype, what you dropped, and how someone can inspect the artifact.
